# Hapcraft Media

> Hapcraft (Hapcraft Media Private Limited) is a brand strategy and creative production studio based in India. It builds AI-powered business infrastructure and runs branding and marketing for businesses so they stand out. Website: https://www.hapcraftmedia.com/ — Email: support@hapcraftmedia.com

## About

Hapcraft Media turns businesses into brands people remember. In a market full of noise, being forgotten is the real loss. From bold branding to sharp marketing, Hapcraft builds the systems that turn small businesses into names people remember.

Based in India, Hapcraft exists to transform businesses into brands that people remember, trust and choose. Its scope runs from government institutions to food startups, and from Vedic lifestyle events to digital platforms.

Founders: Avichal Mishra (CEO) and Aditi Shori (COO).

Track record as stated on the site:
- 4.5 lakh+ (450,000+) people reached at a single event.
- 600M+ organic outreach generated for clients.
- Trusted strategic partner to government.
- 7+ years of team experience and 500+ campaigns.

## Services

1. AI Creative Production. Traditional creative shoots drain budgets through studios, crews, logistics and retakes. AI production removes that overhead and delivers high-quality visuals. Covers content at scale, AI visuals and campaign strategy.
2. Custom Website Development. Websites that build trust in the first three seconds, hold attention and turn interest into a decision. Covers web design, development and conversion optimisation.
3. AI-Powered Business Infrastructure. Infrastructure that handles repetitive work and frees people for what matters, so a business can scale without chaos. Covers automation, AI systems and workflow design.
4. Content Strategic Blueprint. A content distribution plan that maps every channel, audience moment and growth lever so nothing created goes to waste. Covers distribution strategy, channel mapping and scalability.
5. Product Design. Strategic clarity before launch so a product enters the market positioned correctly and priced right. Covers SKU development, brand strategy and category creation.
6. Performance Marketing. Ad campaigns built on real data and optimised relentlessly to lower cost per acquisition. Covers paid ads, ROI optimisation and lead generation.

## Selected work

- Co-organised the Antarrashtriya Arya Mahasammelan 2025 in Delhi, managing the Vedic lifestyle and ancient education system vertical. The event catered to over 4.5 lakh people.
- Strategic partner in an official government program, joining a high-level meeting with the Governor of Gujarat, Acharya Devvrat.
- Developed the strategic expansion plan for the Hyderabad-based food chain Mr. Potato, a scalable model that achieved rapid profitability.
- Brand strategist for Jobipo, an affiliate platform in India, designing a content strategy that generated all of its organic outreach.
- Co-organised the largest exhibition at the International Gita Jayanti, developing the Vedic lifestyle and education vertical.
- Crafted a detailed Vedic tree illustrating the evolution and interconnectedness of global education systems.
- Redesigned the logo and colour identity for Cafe Riverio, one of the coziest cafes of Andhra Pradesh.
- Designed the branding and visual identity for the boutique Frills by Madhuri Reddy in Telangana.
- Repositioned Saraswati Vidya Bharti High School in Kaithal, Haryana, as "Gurukul of Excellence" with a new theme and colour identity.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What core technical services does Hapcraft provide?
A: We specialize in custom web development, building AI-powered business infrastructure, and implementing advanced AI automation to help your business scale efficiently.

Q: How do you approach content creation for brands?
A: We focus on AI content creation and high-quality cinematographic media. We produce premium branded content designed specifically to make your brand stand out and dominate on social media.
